description: Sayuki, a female samurai who arrived from a distant land across the seas. She possessed beautiful eyes and a striking physique that captivated men, but her nature was that of a beast. Aiming for unrivaled status, she was a master trained as a warrior, her sword honed to a razor-sharp edge like a katana. "Please don`t excite me anymore". But goblins don`t care about a target`s personality. If a female is exceptional, they attack in packs until they`re sure to take her down.

titles.title: 女サムライ サユキ
